system_tools.name: fsearch
system_tools.description: Search file names: fsearch <pattern> [paths...]. Search inside files: fsearch <pattern> -f [paths...]. Runs `fsearch find` from the project root with project-wide depth. Do not use find or fzf.

system_tools.name: sd
system_tools.description: Literal edit of any text file: sd <file> <exact old text> <new text>. Uses `sd -F` and refuses when the old text is missing or matches more than once.

system_tools.name: dasel
system_tools.description: Field edit for yaml, json, avsc, toml, xml, and csv: dasel <file> <selector> <value> [string|int|float|bool|json|yaml]. Writes the file in place.

system_tools.name: ast-grep
system_tools.description: Structural rewrite of a repeated pattern: ast-grep <pattern> <lang> <rewrite> [paths...] runs `sg -p <pattern> -l <lang> -r <rewrite>` and applies it. No SQL. Avsc uses the JSON grammar or dasel.

system_tools.name: git apply
system_tools.description: Apply a unified diff for a multi-hunk edit of any text file. Pass the patch file path or the diff on stdin. Use it when sd or dasel does not fit.

system_tools.name: lsp_hover
system_tools.description: Hover information at file:line:column from the language server already attached in Neovim. Does not start a server.

system_tools.name: lsp_definition
system_tools.description: Definition location of the symbol at file:line:column from the attached language server. Does not start a server.

system_tools.name: lsp_references
system_tools.description: All references to the symbol at file:line:column from the attached language server. Does not start a server.

system_tools.name: lsp_rename
system_tools.description: Rename the symbol at file:line:column to a new name through the attached language server. If no server is attached or it cannot rename, say so and use sd, dasel, or git apply. Never rename with sed or awk.

system_tools.name: lua_ls
system_tools.description: Lua language server attached in Neovim. Use through the lsp_* tools.

system_tools.name: yamlls
system_tools.description: YAML language server attached in Neovim (project schemas). Use through the lsp_* tools.

system_tools.name: jsonls
system_tools.description: JSON language server attached in Neovim (project schemas). Use through the lsp_* tools.

system_tools.name: taplo
system_tools.description: TOML language server attached in Neovim. Use through the lsp_* tools.

system_tools.name: jdtls
system_tools.description: Java language server attached in Neovim when `jenv javahome` returns a JDK. Use through the lsp_* tools; rename Java symbols with lsp_rename.

system_tools.name: pyright
system_tools.description: Python type server attached in Neovim. Use through the lsp_* tools.

system_tools.name: ruff
system_tools.description: Python diagnostics and format server attached in Neovim; hover is disabled. Use through the lsp_* tools.

system_tools.name: rust_analyzer
system_tools.description: Rust language server attached in Neovim. Use through the lsp_* tools.

system_tools.name: clangd
system_tools.description: C and C++ language server attached in Neovim. Use through the lsp_* tools.

system_tools.name: arduino_language_server
system_tools.description: Arduino sketch language server attached in Neovim. Use through the lsp_* tools.

system_tools.name: serena
system_tools.description: Serena MCP server started by the supervisor for this agent's project root. Use it with the lsp_* tools to navigate and modify the project.

system_tools.name: agent_create
system_tools.description: Spawn another agent for this project. Does not edit the project, so Ask mode may call it. When a change is needed in Ask mode, call this instead of refusing or telling the user to switch mode. Arguments: --message <instruction> [--name <name>] [--mode edit|ask] [--model <model>] [--manager <manager>]. Default mode is edit. Report the new agent id.

system_tools.name: agent_rename
system_tools.description: Rename one agent of this project. Does not edit the project, so Ask mode may call it. One call renames one agent. Arguments: {"agent": "<agent id>", "name": "<new name>"}. Use the agent id from the system message to rename yourself. If a name matches more than one agent here, pass the agent id.
